description_en: This operation removes IP address entries from the access control policy of a dedicated API Gateway instance
description_zh:
本功能为API网关专享实例提供实例级别的访问控制能力；
在实例的访问控制策略中删除IP条目
name: RemoveAccessControlListEntry

parameters.description_en: The ID of the access control policy.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the access control policy
parameters.name: acl_id

parameters.description_en:
The entries to remove from the access control policy.

- entry: The IP address entry in the access control policy. You can specify an IP address or a CIDR block. Separate multiple IP addresses or CIDR blocks with a comma.

- comment: The comment for the access control policy entry.

> If an access control policy is associated with a listener, deleting all of its IP address entries is not allowed.
parameters.description_zh:
设置访问控制策略组。

* entry：访问控制策略组中的IP条目，可以指定IP地址或IP地址段（CIDR block），多个IP地址/地址段之间用逗号隔开。。

* comment：访问控制策略组备注说明。

>如果访问控制策略组关联了监听，不允许删除组内的所有IP条目。
